info.description: Read-only access to approved, precomputed flood scenarios. Local B2 candidate, pending B1/Team A contract freeze and scientific/production acceptance. Read-only precomputed results; no runtime simulations, publication writes or live telemetry. Examples are synthetic and do not populate the working catalog. Local development is loopback-only and has no login authority. Production safeguards validate hosts, restrict configured browser origins and disable HTTP documentation. CORS is not authorization. Public-versus-protected access and external TLS/proxy policy require deployment-owner agreement before external exposure.
info.title: Ukai Dam Flood Intelligence API
info.x-example-notice: Synthetic HTTP examples only; not predictions, observations, or scientific approval.
